name: Transmute
description: Transmute is a free, open source, self-hosted file converter built for privacy and automation. Convert images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, subtitles, and fonts entirely locally, with no file size limits and no third-party access to your files.

paths.description: Persistent storage for uploads, outputs, and database.
